rows.note: Use this for your wife's mother; it is the all-purpose everyday term for that slice of the meaning.

example.english: My mother-in-law lives in Sai Kung.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 ngoi6 mou2 zyu6 hai2 sai1 gung3

rows.note: Use this for your husband's mother, rather than 外母.

example.english: My mother-in-law’s turnip cake is the best.
example.traditional: 我個奶奶整嘅蘿蔔糕最好食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 naai4 naai2 zing2 ge3 lo4 baak6 gou1 zeoi3 hou2 sik6
